release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.3.7 Drawing Material Takeoff, Dynamic Notes & Launcher Resilience Release:
• Project Material & Strand Takeoff Drawing Table: Embedded comprehensive takeoff summary table in CAD drawings (total tendons, length, weight per direction, slab area, and PT rate kg/m²) with toggle setting.
• Dynamic General Notes: Synchronized PT strand diameter notes with active settings (12.7mm vs 15.2mm), dynamically calculated jacking force per strand (e.g. 138 kN for 12.7mm vs 195 kN for 15.2mm), and eliminated unverified concrete strength (fcu/f'ci) notes unless explicitly extracted from RAM Concept.
• Application Launcher Resilience: Enhanced run_app.bat and main.py startup environment detection to automatically resolve Pillow (PIL) and virtual environment dependencies on all Windows configurations.
• Chair Detailing & Auto-Clash Resolution: Dropdown setting for chair text placement ('Beside' or 'Above' tick indicator) with automatic adjacent tendon clash resolution.
• Chair Spacing Dimension Offset: Added configurable offset distance (mm) from tendon polyline for chair dimensions.
• Tendon ID Block Customization & Template Sync: Configurable ID block color and text height dynamically synced from template DWG/DXF blocks.
• Cutting Length Schedules: Toggle to calculate tendon length and weight with cutting allowance across DXF tables, Excel schedules, and UI takeoff tables.
